name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks quickstart end-to-end. Installed the OpenAI Python SDK (already present), created a script following the quickstart pattern, and received a chat completion response "¡Hola!" from a Fireworks-hosted model via the API.
deviations: The quickstart docs specify model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1`, which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I had to query the models endpoint (`https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models`) to discover available models and substituted `accounts/fireworks/models/gpt-oss-120b` to make the API call succeed. Everything else followed the quickstart exactly.

first_call.evidence: openai.NotFoundError: Error code: 404 - {'error': {'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}, 'request_id': 'chatcmpl-fe7338a450e84770a375b5d5a981bd8d'}

friction.detail: The docs model `accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1` returned `Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed`.
Subsequent attempts with `llama-v3p1-70b-instruct` and `llama-v3-8b-instruct` also failed with `NOT_FOUND`.
The agent had to manually run `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $FIREWORKS_API_KEY" https://api.fireworks.ai/inference/v1/models` to find a valid model ID.

The API repeatedly responded with `{'message': 'Model not found, inaccessible, and/or not deployed', 'param': 'model', 'code': 'NOT_FOUND', 'type': 'error'}` without clarifying whether the name was wrong or access was missing.
